spans.s: अज्येष्ठ [ajyēṣṭha], a. Not the eldest or best, having no elder brothers; ˚वृत्ति not acting like the elder brothers; or acting like one who has no elder brother.
. आज्यधूमोद्गमेन Ś.1.15; (it is often distinguished from घृत; सर्पिर्विलीनमाज्यं स्याद् घनीभूतम् घृतं भवेत्).
(In a wider sense) Oil, milk &c. used instead of clarified butter; घृतं वा यदि वा तैलं पयो वा दधि यावकम् । आज्यस्थाने नियुक्तानामाज्यशब्दो विधीयते ॥
N. of a sort of chant or religious service (सामस्तोमभेदः); आजिमीयुस्तस्मादाज्यानामाज्यत्वम् Nir.

Turpentine. -Comp. -ग्रहः, -पात्रम्, -स्थाली a vessel or dish to hold clarified butter. -दोहम् a hymn to be recited by a Sāmavedin. -प a. drinking ghee. (-पाः pl.) a class of Manes who are the sons of Pulastya and the ancestors of the Vaiśya order; पुलस्त्यस्या- ज्यपाः पुत्राः Mb.;
-8. -भागः A portion of clarified butter; (du.) belonging to Agni and Soma; यदाज्यभागावन्तरेणाहुतीः प्रतिपादयेत्
an epithet of Agni (the consumer of clarified butter).
a god, deity. -वारिः 'sea of clarified butter', one of the seven seas.
